async function run(items: Item[], step: Step) {
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder<Item>(items, step);
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder<Item>(items, step, {reason: "short"});
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await order.inOrder<Item>(items, step, {reason: "short"});
 await inOrder<Item>(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
 const serial = inOrder;
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await serial<Item>(items, step);
 await serial<Item>(items, step, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
}
